patterns.message: Framework-agnostic boundary: src/engine, src/interactions, src/bus, src/windows, src/menus and src/dev must not import a UI framework. Vue was REMOVED from this project (docs/remove-vue-plan.md) — these patterns stay as a ratchet so it cannot creep back. All UI here is plain TS + DOM; see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
Framework-agnostic boundary: no UI framework here. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

src/dev is SCAFFOLDING and must delete cleanly: nothing in engine/, interactions/ or bus/ may import it (CLAUDE.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). The engine declares what it wants measured — see src/engine/RenderProbe.ts — and App.ts injects the instrument.
Framework-agnostic boundary: no UI framework here. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

src/dev is SCAFFOLDING and must delete cleanly: nothing in engine/ may import it (CLAUDE.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). The engine declares what it wants measured — see src/engine/RenderProbe.ts — and App.ts injects the instrument.

The arrow is App.ts -> interactions -> engine, never back: the engine may not import an editor controller, EditorState, or the UI bus (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, DESIGN-PRINCIPLES.md §5). The engine declares the vocabulary it wants and the editor translates into it — see src/engine/rendering/ghostTypes.ts, which exists because a `tool: MarkingTool` parameter in the renderer passed all four gates before this rule (docs/modularity-plan-2026-07-28.md Phase 2).

no-restricted-globals.name: document
no-restricted-globals.message: THE INK HALF DOES NOT MEASURE AT RUNTIME. How much room a glyph needs is answered from Bravura's own metrics (src/engine/fonts/), synchronously, in jsdom, with no font loaded — docs/font-metrics-plan.md F4. Reaching for a canvas here would put the layout back behind the font race that `musicFontReady` exists to survive, and would make every width untestable without a browser. Add a row to the metrics instead: `node scripts/generate-font-metrics.mjs`.

no-restricted-globals.name: window
no-restricted-globals.message: The ink half is pure: staff spaces in, staff spaces out, no DOM — docs/font-metrics-plan.md F4.

no-restricted-globals.name: navigator
no-restricted-globals.message: The ink half is pure: no browser APIs — docs/font-metrics-plan.md F4.

no-restricted-globals.name: getComputedStyle
no-restricted-globals.message: The ink half does not read the page to decide a width. The font's metrics are the source — src/engine/fonts/, docs/font-metrics-plan.md F4.

no-restricted-globals.name: OffscreenCanvas
no-restricted-globals.message: THE INK HALF DOES NOT MEASURE AT RUNTIME — src/engine/fonts/ has the numbers, and they need no canvas. See docs/font-metrics-plan.md F4.

no-restricted-globals.name: ResizeObserver
no-restricted-globals.message: The ink half is pure: no DOM — docs/font-metrics-plan.md F4.

patterns.message: src/engine/fonts is the FONT AS DATA and must not know who draws with it: no VexFlow, no renderer. It is the one module a future engine keeps unchanged when the drawing moves (docs/own-engraving-engine.md P2/P3).

The ink half must not consult the drawing library to decide how much room ink needs — that is the coupling docs/font-metrics-plan.md §3.1 is about (a table calibrated to VexFlow's BEHAVIOUR describes nothing the day VexFlow stops drawing). Measure the font instead: src/engine/fonts/. ⚠️ Importing engine/rendering/layoutConfig is still allowed and is a separate, older arrow.
